description: GET ONLY the 'CommunityMarketing' field of TitlePublicConfigurationModel. Community Marketing - the program that rewards community members for posting about the game on external social platforms (YouTube/TikTok/Instagram). A campaign declares WHO may take part (Participation + SegmentGate), WHEN it runs (ScheduleSpec), WHICH platforms count and at what weight, WHAT the post must contain (hashtags, mention, the creator verification code), and HOW it pays: RateCards give a linear rate per metric (e.g. 60 GOLD per 1000 views, optionally multiplied by a per-submission moderator coefficient), while Milestones give threshold rewards using the shared platform milestone primitive. Spending is bounded by a campaign Budget plus per-submission, per-creator and per-team Caps - all evaluated against what has been PAID, never what has been earned. Providers says where the view/like/comment/share numbers come from per platform (the title's own API key or aggregator key, addressed BY NAME in TitleSecrets - never the value itself), Moderation says what a human reviews, and AntiFraud sets the hold period before earnings mature plus the anomaly thresholds that freeze a suspicious submission. Creators, submissions, metric snapshots, accruals and the payout journal are NOT here - they are operational data in their own collections. The Community Marketing pool bucket is funded by a fee on player crypto withdrawals, configured in the Currency section (CryptoCurrencyDefinition.CommunityMarketingWithdrawalFeePercent), not here.
name: get_community_marketing
